description: Graded dirt, wide enough for something with a trailer on it, running east toward a wall that from here does not appear to have a way through. Tyre ruts, and the marks where heavy things have been dragged off the road and left. Off toward the middle of the country there is a wall, and above the wall, catching the light, a long row of glass roofs. Something is growing in there. Not for you.
name: The Road
